intro.text: A family of Rosharan plants that thrive in the Shattered Plains chasms, growing bigger there than elsewhere.
A family of Rosharan plants with fanlike fronds that fold up like a fist when startled. Frillbloom is common in the Shattered Plains chasms, where it grows larger than elsewhere.

description.text: In the chasms, Kaladin sees lifespren dancing about the frillbloom.
Species come in yellow, orange, red and violet. Some have veined fronds; others have spines at the leaf tips.
Frillbloom also closes up when a storm is coming.
